messages:
lina: Opened PR to update caspian6b model card: clarify which quant variants are production vs experimental, add a short bench note, and fix a dead internal anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/560

kevin: Nice. Can you add sequence_limit and the tokenization note? Some customers hit mismatches when context and tokenizer differ.

lina: Added sequence_limit: 5120 and a short tokenizer note about BPE edge cases for long prompts.

ara: Can we include a tiny Python snippet showing how to detect server-side runtime and log fallbacks? Keep it minimal.

lina: Snippet added in the PR:
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("Translate to FR", model="caspian6b:quant-int4")
print(resp.text)
if getattr(resp, "runtime", "gpu") != "gpu":
    print("Fallback detected:", resp.runtime)
```

omar: Please attach raw bench logs or a gist for the med/p95 numbers you added so infra can sanity-check them.

lina: Gist uploaded: https://gist.github.com/lina/caspian6b-bench-560 (includes run script and CSV)

kevin: Add a one-line Dedicated migration tip: pinned GPU pools may need kernel upgrades to avoid fallbacks. Also small wording tweak in the compatibility paragraph.

lina: Added Dedicated checklist and updated compat wording. Fixed anchor /models/caspian -> /catalog/caspian6b. Will squash and request reviews.

docs-bot: PR opened by lina: #560 — reviewers requested: @kevin @ara @omar

kevin: I'll review the bench methodology tomorrow morning.

ara: I'll proof the headings and the snippet style later today.

lina: Thanks all, will ping support and runbook owners after merge. (END)
